description: This file contains utility functions for managing and building tree structures related to dashboard layout, charts, and filters in Apache Superset. It includes functions for generating tree nodes, filtering checked items, and determining filter scope within a dashboard layout.

methods.name: isShowTypeInTree
methods.description: Checks if a layout item should be shown in the tree based on its type.

methods.name: getNodeTitle
methods.description: Retrieves the display title for a layout node, considering overrides and fallback options.

methods.name: generateChartSubNodes
methods.description: Generates sub-nodes for a chart, especially for 'deck_multi' viz types, representing deck layers.

methods.name: buildTree
methods.description: Recursively builds a tree structure of layout items, creating nodes for charts and tabs, and attaching sub-nodes.

methods.name: addInvisibleParents
methods.description: Adds parent nodes that are invisible in the tree to ensure proper hierarchy.

methods.name: checkTreeItem
methods.description: Recursively checks tree items and their invisible parents, marking charts as checked if applicable.

methods.name: getTreeCheckedItems
methods.description: Determines which items are checked in the tree based on the filter scope and selected layers.

methods.name: findFilterScope
methods.description: Finds the first common parent scope for selected charts, tabs, or filters.

methods.name: getDefaultScopeValue
methods.description: Provides default filter scope values, including root path and excluded charts.
